subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core session-level process/step event contract now, and what taxonomy, persistence, replay, authorization, and redaction boundary should own it?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but the correct contract affects gateway protocol, client replay, plugin event seams, session state, and security boundaries; automation should not choose that API shape alone.

options.title: Design core event contract first
options.body: Specify the process/step taxonomy, storage/replay model, observer scopes, redaction rules, and mappings from current agent item/tool/plan streams before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to surface-specific progress
options.body: Handle sessions_send, Control UI, and CLI stdout progress as separate smaller features without committing to a general session process-event API yet.

options.title: Defer the process API
options.body: Keep existing live agent/session/tool streams and revisit when ClawWork or plugin consumers provide a concrete external contract requirement.

recommendation.title: Design core event contract first
recommendation.body: Specify the process/step taxonomy, storage/replay model, observer scopes, redaction rules, and mappings from current agent item/tool/plan streams before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent and historical connection to the structured event surfaces and core gateway contract shape.
